statement_summary: Annual risk assessment using SP 800-30 and SP 800-82 threat guidance
Risk acceptance authority; no High acceptance of safety or environmental risks
Safety first: no security measure may bypass safety shutdowns; OT change impact review
Sanctions
Supplier security schedule before SCADA access or Restricted data
Annual recheck of applicable cybersecurity laws and rules
Unique accounts; documented compensating controls for OCC shared HMI stations
MFA for email, SaaS, VPN, cloud admin, and all remote SCADA access
Vendor remote access only through the jump host, per-session approval, recorded
Same-day access removal including SCADA local accounts
Quarterly access reviews including SCADA accounts
Change default passwords before connecting any device
IT/OT boundary through the OT DMZ; no dual-homed devices; no internet-reachable field management
Badge access to the OCC; field keys and combinations logged and changed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour; Production Controllers report odd HMI behavior
Authority to isolate the SCADA network
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix
Annual joint IT and operations tabletop
Encrypt Restricted data; document OT exceptions
Wipe or certified destruction of media, including retired OT devices
Isolated, immutable, offline backups including controller programs; quarterly restore test
Annual training for all staff including field crews; quarterly phishing exercises
No USB or personal devices on SCADA equipment; scanning kiosk
Approved generative AI tools only
